limitations: Selection and metadata validation are not fresh-host reconstruction evidence.
Historical exclusion records are inherited exact-content evidence, not a new contamination scan.
Graph rendering metadata certifies only the original per-task AI spotcheck scope.
ChartQA OCR payloads are regenerated privately with pinned non-LLM extraction; raw OCR text is never published.

hf-chartqa.upstream_origin: ChartQA human-written questions (AMT) over Statista/Pew/OWID/OECD charts

hf-chebi-role.upstream_origin: ChEBI curators' has_role annotations, quoted from the ChEBI-20-MM description; image from ChEBI-20-MM

hf-clevr.upstream_origin: Original CLEVR v1.0 rendered scenes and functional-program answers (Johnson et al. 2017)

hf-deepweeds.upstream_origin: DeepWeeds expert species labels (Olsen et al. 2019)

hf-gvlqa.upstream_origin: GVLQA-BASE question/answer pairs generated by the dataset creators' graph programs (Wei et al. 2024)

hf-mapqa.upstream_origin: MapQA templates over KFF/US data via the_cauldron

hf-nctcrc.upstream_origin: NCT-CRC-HE expert tissue labels (Kather et al. 2019)

hf-plantvillage.upstream_origin: PlantVillage expert class labels (Mohanty et al. 2016)

hf-ptbxl.upstream_origin: PTB-XL cardiologist statements (Wagner et al. 2020); image rendered by program from the signal

hf-ssmr.upstream_origin: SSMR-Bench programmatic sheet-music QA (rule-based, no LLM)
